posts.title: Bundling your Node.js web app into a single executable using Bun
posts.description: In my recent project, Chatfall , I successfully bundled an entire Node.js web app into a single executable using Bun . A native executable binary is generated for every supported platform that internally contains all of the following: ElysiaJS backend. ReactJS frontend web app. Drizzle ORM migration scripts.
